contexts.text: The height (of Noah's ark) = the good (of remains).
Here, high = what is holy; hence mountains, from their height above the earth, = the Lord, and His holy celestial things.
He became black... and was thus carried on high...

When they saw any high mountain, they did not perceive the idea of a mountain, but that of height; and from the height they perceived Heaven and the Lord; thence it came to pass that the Lord was said to dwell in the highest, and He Himself was called the Most High.
Beneath the feet are the Hells which correspond to those who are on high...
Therefore the love of self... is called height... and is described by all things which are high. Illustrated.
For He is not in the highest, but in the inmost things; and therefore in the Word the highest and the inmost has the same signification.
By phantasies, Spirits can in a moment be carried up on high; nay, up to the highest...
In the internal sense the idea of a mountain perishes, and there remains the idea of height; and by height is represented holiness.
He was carried on high, and so seemed to himself to be the sole governor of the universe...
To God Most High () = the internal man, who is Jehovah. AC 1732. AC 1735.

In the Ancient Church Jehovah was called God Most High, because height represented what is internal; thus the highest represented what is inmost; hence the worship of the Ancient Church upon lofty places... Moreover, what is inmost in relation to what is exterior and outermost is circumstanced no otherwise than as what is highest is to what is lower and lowest. What is highest or inmost is the Celestial of love, or love itself; Jehovah, or the Internal of the Lord, was... love itself...

A Spirit... was suddenly taken up on high... I supposed that he was of those who aspire to high things; for such are wont to be carried on high; or that he had placed Heaven in what is highest, who in like manner are wont to be taken up on high, in order that they may know that Heaven is not in what is high, but in what is internal. But... he was taken up to the angelic Spirits (and witnessed the wonders of the Word). AC 3474. SE 2053.
Interior things are expressed by... to think high things, because man supposes Heaven to be on high... when yet it is not on high, but in internal things... AC 2242:2. AC 3387:end. AC 4103.
The height and length of the branches = its extension.
Because celestial things, which are of love and charity, were represented by those things which were high...
The most deceitful sometimes appear high above the head...
In truths and goods, which is to be in the heights of the field.

For mountains from their height signified the things which were high; as the things of Heaven, which are called celestial things... Hence it is that where high is mentioned in the Word, in the internal sense, it = what is interior...
The root of evil lies deeply hidden.
The Lord as a Sun appears... at a middle height... HH 118. DLW 103. DLW 105, Explained.
(The lowly being high in Heaven. Explained.)
Height = good. References.
Hence height is predicated of good.

Interior things are described by things which are high; but with the difference that they who are in evils and falsities believe themselves to be high and above others, but they who are in goods and truths believe themselves to be below others. But still goods and truths are described by high things, because in Heaven they are nearer the Most High...
By changes of state Spirits can be presented on high, and deep down, in a moment.
The evil of the love of self is described by the height of the cedars.

When the most Ancients ascended a mountain, the height struck them, and from the height what is holy, from the fact that the Lord was said to dwell in the Highest; and because height in the spiritual sense was the good of love.
As high signified Heaven and the Divine therein. Divine worship was instituted upon mountains and upon high places.

The reason the Divine is signified by high, is that by the starry heaven is signified the angelic Heaven... but the wiser of them knew that Heaven is not on high, but where the good of love is, and this is within man... That high things = interior things, or the goods which are there. References.
Before the external sight of Spirits, Heaven is on high; but before the internal sight... it is in what is internal...
It is states of truth and good, and in the opposite sense of falsity and evil, which are represented in the other life by heights and depths. References.

A cubit and a half the height thereof () = full as to degrees. (9531.) Height = degrees as to good and as to truth. The reason height signifies this, is that all good and the derivative truth proceed from the Lord, and the Lord is in the highest, and is therefore called the Most High; for He is the Sun of Heaven... All heights in Heaven from its Sun as the centre, are differences of good and the derivative truth...
The height of Zion () = celestial good...
The height (of the cedar) = the degree of good.
Height, in the opposite sense, = the evil of the love of self, thus elation of mind. Illustrated.
The reason height = degrees as to good and the derivative truth, is that high = what is internal; and good is perfect according to degrees towards the interiors. AC 9773, Explained.
Three cubits the height () = fill as to degrees... Height = degrees as to good.

The height five cubits () = the degrees of good and truth as much as is sufficient Height = degrees as to good; and as it is predicated of the Ultimate Heaven, it also = degrees as to truth; for that Heaven is in the good and truth of faith.
They who are on high can clearly see those who are below, and the higher they are the further they can see; and they can... also speak to them.

Its height two cubits () = the degrees of good and truth, and their conjunction... Height = the degrees of good and the derivative truth. By degrees of height are meant degrees from interiors to exteriors... References.

The Lord is called the Most High because He is perfection, intelligence, wisdom, good and truth itself; and hence it is that Heaven is said to be on high, because it is in perfection, intelligence, wisdom, good and truth from the Lord...
In Heaven... by height is meant the difference (of good and truth) according to degrees; (for) height in Heaven is according to degrees. DLW 71:2. AE 629:4. Explained.
The Hells had grown to such a height...
The evil of theft enters more deeply with man than any other evil.
Many bring with them the idea of God that He is high above the head... because in the Word He is called the Most High... not knowing that by the highest is signified the inmost. DLW 206, Explained.
On degrees of height. (See Degree.)
A great and high mountain () = the Third Heaven, where are they who are in love to the Lord, and in the doctrine of genuine truth from Him... High is predicated of truths.
A wall great and high () = the Word as to Divine good and Divine truth; for high is predicated of truth.

The length, and the breadth, and the height of it are equal () = that all things of that Church are from the good of love... By height is signified good and truth together in every degree; for height includes from the highest to the lowest, and the highest descends to the lowest through degrees, which are called degrees of height, in which are the Heavens from the Highest to the Ultimate.
The power of the Highest = Divine good.
On Spirits who are very high up. SE 718. SE 867. SE 2374. SE 3057.
Evil Spirits who are swollen with the love of self, for the most part are on high... SE 2375.
That height and distances are appearances... They who are beneath the feet are at once on high...
In this passage there are mentioned only things which are high. Enumerated, Explained.
They suppose they are in Heaven when they are on high...
The reason why Spirits are carried on high, and downwards. Explained.
On the subtle evil Spirits in the line of the zenith, at various heights.
There spoke to me those of the Most Ancient Church, who are in the highest; for a higher can scarcely exist. They said... they did not know why they are at that height...
They suppose themselves to be on high, when yet they are near Gehenna. Explained. See SE 4086. SE 4574.
All Spirits in whom the love of self is seated believe Heaven to consist in what is high...
To the third and fourth degree of height (of the evil there); the worst are the highest...
They were shown that they were not on high, but in the Hells... AE 510:2.
Height = what is internal.
Haughty from height () = glorying from... Own intelligence.
The army of height upon height () = all the evils which are from the love of self... For those in the love of self in the Spiritual World seek high places. AE 405:30.
Everyone who is magnificent and high () = those who are in the love of self and of the world.
They convey themselves up to heights by then phantasies... Signified by holding the height of the hill ().
The love of falsity is signified by a sepulchre in the height ().
The heights of the field () = the interior things of the Church, from which is combat. AE 447:4.
To destroy the pride of man, and the height of men () = the destruction of pride from Own intelligence and knowledge.
Height = the degrees of good and truth from the highest or inmost things to the lowest or ultimate ones.
Heaven is called high from the Third Heaven (down to) the First Heaven... and therefore by height is signified wisdom and intelligence as to degrees.
The height above all the trees of the field () = elevation even to the interior Rational...
The height thereof () = the extension of the perception and the derivative wisdom.
High, with the ancients, signified Heaven; whence came the rite of sacrificing upon high mountains; and in place of them on lofty places but on high.
The influx from Heaven into them is signified by, The spirit shall be poured out upon you from on high ().
The pride of Own intelligence is signified by the height of the people of the earth ().
To make the Most High his habitation () = (protection).
Hence it is that the Lord, being in the inmost, is called the Most High, and is said to dwell in the highest.
The good of charity is signified by the mountain of the height of Israel ().
It is granted them... to see some one on high...
Redeemer. 4. 5. The Highest is said of the Divine good; and therefore the power of the Highest = the power which proceeds from the Divine good.
